home.aboutP1: Bete — "house" in Amharic — connects buyers and renters directly with real estate agencies and agents across Ethiopia.
home.aboutP2: Sellers and agencies post properties; buyers browse and contact them directly. Verification and AI-assisted moderation make listings easier to trust.
home.aboutP3: The marketplace speaks five languages: English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Tigrinya, and Somali.

listing.q: How long until my listing goes live?
listing.a: New and edited listings start as PENDING. An admin reviews AI flags and publishes LIVE listings, usually within one business day.

verification.q: How do I become a verified seller?
verification.a: Apply as a seller and submit verification documents. Verified means role SELLER and verification_status VERIFIED â€” they are separate statuses.

payment.a: All listing prices are shown in Ethiopian Birr (ETB). Boost and renewals will bill in ETB when those products launch.
